Title: NASA Discovers Water on Mars
Text:

NASA scientists have found evidence of liquid water flowing on Mars. The discovery was made using high-resolution images from the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter. This raises possibilities of microbial life existing on the red planet.

Title: Fed holds interest rates steady, lowers 2019 projection to two hikes

Text: The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady Wednesday and lowered its forecast to two hikes in 2019. This marks a shift from the earlier prediction of three hikes, citing global economic uncertainty.
